My name is Max Patterson and I'm a student at the University of The South in Sewanee TN. In this blog I am sharing the Github repositories I completed for a course called Data storytelling and sustainable development. Each post explores the transition towards a more sustainable future according to the sustainable development goals determined at the Rio summit in 2026.
